items.question: Who owns KAYAK?
items.answer:
KAYAK is owned by Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), which acquired the company in 2013. Booking Holdings is a global leader in online travel.



KAYAK was founded by Steve Hafner and Paul English in 2004. Steve Hafner was KAYAK's CEO until February 2026, Peer Bueller is now the current CEO.

items.question: What is KAYAK and how does it work?
items.answer:
KAYAK is a travel search engine that helps you find and compare flights, hotels, rental cars, and vacation packages.



We search hundreds of travel sites at once to show you all your options in one place.



How KAYAK works.



When you search on KAYAK, here's what happens:




We scan hundreds of travel sites simultaneously to find available options for your trip



You see results from airlines, hotels, online travel agencies, and car rental companies side by side



You compare prices, times, and features all in one place



When you're ready to book, you click through to the partner's site (like the airline or hotel) to complete your reservation



We don't handle the booking ourselves - we connect you directly to the provider




For more details on how to explore and compare travel options, visit our Search and discovery guide.



What you can search on KAYAK.




Flights - Compare airlines and find the best flight options



Hotels and stays - Search accommodations across booking sites



Rental cars - Find car rental deals from major providers



Vacation packages - Bundle flights and hotels together




You can start searching directly on KAYAK's homepage.



Is KAYAK a reliable travel site?



Yes. KAYAK is part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), a global leader in online travel. We've been in business since 2004 and are trusted by millions of travelers who use our platform to process billions of searches each year.



For more information.




See KAYAK's award wins for helping travelers make smarter choices.



Explore innovative features like KAYAK.ai.

items.question: How is KAYAK organized?
items.answer:
KAYAK is an agile, data-driven organization built around empowering travelers to make confident decisions. The company operates as a meta-search engine that brings together hundreds of travel sites, allowing users to compare flights, hotels, car rentals, and vacation packages in one place.



Its structure emphasizes collaboration between product, marketing, and tech teams, ensuring constant innovation and an exceptional user experience. With a culture rooted in experimentation and learning from data, KAYAK continually refines its products to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital travel landscape.



At the organizational level, KAYAK maintains a global presence while fostering a local mindset. Teams across markets work semi-autonomously but stay connected through shared goals, clear communication, and strong cross-functional partnerships.



KAYAK’s values of being bold, owning it and winning as one shape how teams work and how decisions are made. This blend of entrepreneurial energy, data-driven thinking and collaboration keeps the company innovative and efficient, all while staying focused on its mission to make travel easier for everyone.



KAYAK's Global Footprint.




60+ international sites across the world



25+ site languages for travelers worldwide



15 international offices



800+ team members supporting our platforms




For more information.

items.question: Does KAYAK charge commission?
items.answer:
No, KAYAK does not charge you a commission or any extra fees. The prices you see come directly from travel providers, and our service is completely free to use.



How does KAYAK make money?



KAYAK earns revenue from our travel partners and advertisers, not from you:



Commissions from partners:




When you click through to a partner (like an airline or online travel agency) and book, KAYAK may earn a commission from that partner.



This doesn't cost you extra. The provider pays us for the redirect or booking assist.



Commission models include per-click or per-booking.




Advertising:




Some partners promote their results on KAYAK through sponsored listings, which are always clearly labeled.



KAYAK also displays travel-related ads, and some partners pay when users click on them.




For more information.




Learn more about how KAYAK works and what sets our tools apart.

items.question: Is KAYAK a travel agency?
items.answer:
No, KAYAK is not a travel agency. We're a travel search engine (also called a metasearch engine) that helps you find and compare options from hundreds of travel sites, then book directly with the provider you choose.



KAYAK searches hundreds of travel sites to show you flights, hotels, rental cars and vacation packages all in one place. We help you compare your options so you can make the best decision for your trip.



When you find a deal you like and click through to book, you'll leave KAYAK and complete your reservation directly with that travel provider (whether that's an airline, hotel, online travel agency, or another partner).



In some cases, you can complete a booking with a third-party travel provider without leaving KAYAK's website. This is listed as the "Book on KAYAK" option in the search results.



What KAYAK does.




Compare 100s of travel sites in seconds



Search multiple routes and date options in one search to find the best deal



Know the best time to book with real-time Price Alerts



Find what actually works for you (like nonstop only flights or bags included) with KAYAK filters



Access private flight deals on the KAYAK App




What KAYAK doesn't do.




KAYAK doesn't sell flight tickets or make reservations ourselves



KAYAK doesn't handle payments for your bookings



KAYAK doesn't act as your travel agent




For more information.




Organize and manage your trips with KAYAK Trips

items.question: What differentiates KAYAK from other metasearch engines?
items.answer:
KAYAK is a pioneer in travel metasearch. Since its launch in 2004, KAYAK has pushed the boundaries of how travelers search, compare, and plan trips online. Today, KAYAK is a leading travel search engine.



A culture of innovation and experimentation.



KAYAK’s success is built on a culture grounded in innovation, data, and continuous improvement.




We continually tests and refine our products to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital travel landscape.



KAYAK was the first mainstream travel company to introduce AI-powered conversational search, enabling travelers to plan trips through natural dialogue in KAYAK AI Mode



This forward-thinking approach ensures travelers always have access to the most advanced and seamless tools available




Smart tools that empower travelers.



KAYAK sets itself apart through a range of intelligent, easy-to-use features that simplify every stage of the travel journey:




Trusted by millions of travelers, the KAYAK app makes travel planning seamless on iOS and Android.



KAYAK.ai-powered travel assistant: Gives you personalized travel tips & advice and lets you book with live prices all in one place. Discover more about KAYAK.ai



Price Forecast: Predicts the likelihood of flight prices rising or dropping within 30 days, helping travelers decide whether to book now or wait



Explore: Inspires spontaneous travel by showing destinations within a chosen budget — with filters for flight length, date, and interests



Trips: A personal travel assistant that lets users organize, manage, and share itineraries, track results, and receive real-time flight status alerts



Price Alerts: Keeps users updated when prices change for flights, hotels, or car rentals, ensuring they never miss a great deal




Recognition and trust.



KAYAK’s excellence is reflected in the trust of its users and in the many awards it has earned over the years:




Frommer’s ranked KAYAK (and momondo) the #1 Best (and Cheapest) Airfare Search Site for 2025 and the #1 best overall airfare search site for 2024



World Travel Tech Awards named KAYAK the World’s Best Flight Comparison Website and World’s Best Hotel Comparison Website for three consecutive years (2022–2024).



Statista & COMPUTER BILD recognized KAYAK as a Top Online Platform 2025.




Learn more about KAYAK's awards.

items.question: How do I apply for a job at KAYAK?
items.answer:
If you’re interested in working at KAYAK, here’s how you can apply and get started:



How to apply.




Go to the Careers at KAYAK page.



Search for open positions (“open positions,” “jobs,” or “careers”) and filter by location, department or role.



Click on a specific role that interests you, read the full job description and requirements, then submit your application (typically via an online form).



Make sure your CV/resumé and cover letter reflect your relevant experience, skills and how you align with KAYAK’s mission and values.



Once you apply, you may receive updates from the recruitment team if your application moves forward.




What makes KAYAK a unique place to work?




KAYAK offers a flexible hybrid model, with team members working from the office three days a week, and the freedom to come in more often if they like.



We emphasise career growth, providing opportunities for skill development and supporting individual learning.



The company is committed to inclusion, with employee-resource groups for under-represented communities and a global equal-pay policy.




You’ll be joining a global network: KAYAK is part of a broader portfolio of brands and is owned by Booking Holdings, Inc.




Watch out for fraudulent job adverts.



KAYAK will never request payment(s) from its candidates for open positions and wouldn’t request Credit Card information by phone, email, WhatsApp or social media. If you receive a suspicious request regarding a career opportunity at KAYAK, please report it using our feedback form.

How it works.



When you join the program, you get access to KAYAK and its partner brands (including Momondo, Cheapflights, HotelsCombined, and others) through a single platform.



What you can earn.




Earn 50% commission on clicks, bookings, and ad revenue



Monetize multiple travel categories in one program



Access billions of annual searches and 5M+ hotels and properties to promote




Integration options.



Add KAYAK tools to your site via deep links, widgets, search boxes, white-label solutions, or API integration, with technical support to tailor them to your needs.



Getting started.



Create a KAYAK Affiliate Network account, integrate your chosen tools, and start earning once live. Track performance and revenue in real time through the affiliate portal.



Support.

items.question: What airlines are not on KAYAK?
items.answer:
As a metasearch engine, KAYAK scans hundreds of travel sites and displays available options, but coverage depends on which airlines and booking sites participate in our platform.



Why you might not see a specific airline.



An airline may not appear in your search results for a few reasons:




You've filtered out booking sites with certain airlines' results



The airline doesn't operate the route you're searching for



The airline doesn't participate in KAYAK's search results for your market or route




How to check if an airline is on KAYAK.



Search the Airlines page:Visit KAYAK's Airlines page to see if your airline is listed. This page shows airline names, IATA codes, and contact details for airlines we work with.



Run a route-specific search:Search for a flight on a route you know the airline operates. Check if the airline appears as a booking option in your results.



Review your filters:Make sure you haven't excluded booking sites that might offer tickets for that airline. KAYAK lets you filter results to include or exclude certain providers. Learn more about how to explore and compare travel options on KAYAK.

items.question: Is KAYAK a safe website?
items.answer:
Yes, KAYAK is a legitimate travel search engine owned by Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) since 2013. We've been helping travelers search for flights, hotels, and rental cars since 2004, processing billions of queries across hundreds of travel sites.



Here's what you need to know about how KAYAK works and stays secure.



How KAYAK actually works.



KAYAK is a search engine not a booking site. You search with us, but you book directly with airlines, hotels, or other travel providers. This means:




You never pay KAYAK directly for flights or hotels



Your payment goes to the airline, hotel, or travel agency you choose



KAYAK earns a commission from partners when you click through and book




KAYAK's security measures.



We take security seriously and maintain:




A 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) monitoring our systems



Regular external audits to ensure protection and compliance



The NIST Cybersecurity Framework guiding our security program



A vulnerability reporting channel via HackerOne




Read more on KAYAK security systems.



You can also review our Privacy Policy to understand how your data is handled.



How to spot official KAYAK communications.



Legitimate KAYAK URLs:




Always contain "KAYAK" followed by the local domain (kayak.com, kayak.co.uk, kayak.fr)



Variations like "kayakonline," "kayakworking," or "kayakagent" are scams




Official KAYAK will never:




Call, email, or message you via WhatsApp to complete a booking



Request payment from you directly



Send unsolicited messages via email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, or Instagram



Ask job candidates to pay for positions




Official KAYAK emails:




Come from @kayak.com addresses only



Never from Gmail, Yahoo, or other free email services




If you suspect a scam.



Take these steps immediately:




Contact your bank regarding any fraudulent payments



Report to your local law enforcement:



US: Visit the US government fraud and scam site



Canada: Anti Fraud Center Canada



Australia: Australian Cyber Security Centre



UK: Action Fraud



Europe: Europol



Report suspicious activity to KAYAK at www.kayak.com/feedback/form




Bottom line.



KAYAK is safe to use as a search tool. Just remember: you're booking with the airline or hotel, not with us. Always verify you're on an official KAYAK domain, and never send payment to anyone claiming to be KAYAK.



For more information.




Help and customer support

results.title: Kayak CEO Steve Hafner Exits Post After 22 Years
results.description: Don't expect Hafner to stick around for an extended period in the new executive chair role.
extra_snippets: Parent company Booking Holdings announced Tuesday morning that it appointed chief financial officer Peer Bueller as Kayak CEO, and Hafner has become executive chair, a newly created position. The announcement did not give a reason for the leadership shuffle, but said Hafner "will take on a new leadership role at Booking Holdings focused on advancing AI innovation." The company provided no further details on the new role. Bueller became Kayak CFO in 2016 and added chief operating officer to his duties in 2021.
Hafner and chief technology officer Paul English co-founded Kayak in 2004, and it became one of the leading companies in what was then a hot category, travel metasearch.

Booking Holdings acquired Kayak in 2013, Expedia Group took a controlling interest in Trivago that same year, and China's Trip.com Group scooped up Skyscanner in 2016. Expedia and Hotels.com are among many non-Booking Holdings brands that advertise on Kayak today.
Kayak co-founder and CEO Steve Hafner, who took the company public in 2012 and sold it to Booking Holdings for $2.1 billion the next year, is out as CEO after 22 years.

results.description: KAYAK co-founder Steve Hafner is stepping down as CEO after 22 years. The company named Peer Bueller, KAYAK’s CFO since 2016 and COO since 2021, as the new CEO.
extra_snippets: Last update: Feb 06, 2026 · Share · KAYAK co-founder Steve Hafner is stepping down as CEO after 22 years. The company named Peer Bueller, KAYAK’s CFO since 2016 and COO since 2021, as the new CEO. Hafner will move into a newly created executive chair role at KAYAK and also take on a separate role at Booking Holdings focused on AI innovation.

Booking framed Bueller as the executive who has been driving expansion, growing KAYAK for Business, and pushing commercial innovation—signals that the company wants sharper execution on growth and monetization.
KAYAK is a major comparison and discovery tool, so leadership changes can influence how travelers search, how suppliers allocate marketing spend, and which features are prioritized.
Booking’s CEO Glenn Fogel praised Hafner for pioneering metasearch and delivering strong results since Booking bought KAYAK in 2013.
